# Sheraz Zafar

> Sheraz Zafar is a senior product and systems engineer based in Pakistan, available for selected remote engagements worldwide.

## Professional focus

Product and SaaS engineering, AI integration and retrieval systems, production reliability, real-time workflows, backend APIs, and end-to-end product delivery.

## Experience

Five years of software product engineering across SaaS, AI-enabled workflows, integrations, realtime features, and production systems. Technologies used across projects include React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, Laravel/PHP, Python/Django, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, and cloud platforms.

## Services

- [Product engineering for SaaS teams](https://sherazdevsolutions.com/services/product-engineering/): Own a defined product area from technical discovery through implementation and handover.
- [AI integration and retrieval systems](https://sherazdevsolutions.com/services/ai-integration/): Add document intelligence, retrieval, extraction, and model-assisted workflows to product applications.
- [Production reliability and systems engineering](https://sherazdevsolutions.com/services/production-reliability/): Investigate production behavior across APIs, data, queues, realtime features, integrations, and deployment.
